messages:
rachel: opened PR #633 to streamline the HelloQuickstart: single-file examples, explicit auth var name, tiny Dockerfile, and an optional Node snippet. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/633
 tom: love the single-file approach. please note SDK v7+ uses REDWOOD_API_KEY and show Authorization: Bearer in curl.
 ini: add a one-liner for PowerShell and Windows cmd. beginners keep tripping over env var syntax.
 rachel: added PowerShell ($env:REDWOOD_API_KEY=\"KEY\") and cmd (setx REDWOOD_API_KEY \"KEY\"). moved Docker snippet next to deploy paragraph per feedback.
 docs-bot: preview build queued for PR #633
 preview-bot: preview failed  broken link in /getting-started/helloworld.md -> ./old/hello.md (404)
 rachel: oops, stale cross-ref. updating to /examples/helloworld/app.md and repushing.
 docs-bot: preview ready  https://deploy-preview-633.docs.redwood.ai/preview (diff: hello quickstart, auth copy, docker placement, node/python snippets)
 tom: tiny copy change: replace "set your key" with "export REDWOOD_API_KEY in your shell". otherwise LGTM.
 ini: LGTM after copy tweak. squash commits before merge?
 rachel: will squash. CI green, merging now. merged PR #633 f389 closing thread.
